pages.text: Depth Vases can be obtained by altering a Decorated Pot. Similarly to a Pot, they can hold items inside, with the main difference being their varying internal storage. Despite its size, a Depth Vase can hold a ludicrously high amount of items, up to three times as much as a Barrel. However, that depends on how deep in the world it is. The closer to bedrock it is, the more storage space it has.

If placed as high in the sky as possible, it will match the storage of a Decorated Pot. It's important to note that because of the small opening at the top, it's not possible to see the contents - unlike with a chest. If there is an item at the very bottom of the Vase, all items inside have to be taken out to get access to the desired one.
